hosting.//: Firebase's default ignore list contains '**/.*', which silently excludes .well-known and would make did:web resolution 404. Exclusions are enumerated explicitly instead.

headers.//: XRPC endpoints are extensionless, so Firebase would infer application/octet-stream and the AppView's client would reject them.

functions.//: Deploy artifact only: index.js is the esbuild bundle of src/functions/index.ts, entries.json comes from build.ts, and neither is committed. See npm run build:functions.
